dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid high-intensity white and light-grey clusters is observed on the posterior lateral flank, with core pixel concentrations appearing as asymmetrical, non-gradient blobs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An irregular quadrilateral is formed by connecting the centroids of the two largest dorsal 'O' structures with the two most prominent high-intensity blobs located on the posterior flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The overall texture exhibits a complex, interconnected reticulated network of high-contrast lines that spans the majority of the visible dorsal and lateral surfaces.
